scope: two newly selected card/range inputs on known public betting templates; independently retrained finite spots; no unseen-template, zero-shot, global or default-agent claim
novelty_rule: reject any existing or already selected (sorted flop ranks, turn rank) signature, regardless of suits; never select by tree size, strategy, exploitability or reference value

board_rules.wet: four distinct board ranks; three distinct flop ranks within span four and exactly two flop suits
board_rules.dry: four distinct board ranks; three flop ranks pairwise separated by at least three and three distinct flop suits

range_rule: after each accepted board, draw eight distinct remaining cards without replacement for two physical combos per seat, then four independent integer weights 1..3

training.initialization: one exact uniform iteration charged to node work
training.crossing: first complete iteration at or above each label, including initialization and overshoot
training.assignment: fixed path order, index modulo three

decision.positive: medium/dry per-spot paired median <= -0.001 initial pots; low/wet per-spot paired median <= +0.001; pooled six-pair median < 0; candidate passes all historical absolute quality gates in both spots
decision.negative: medium/dry paired median >= +0.001 initial pots or candidate fails an absolute quality gate
decision.inconclusive: all other complete outcomes; a failed source, compute or numerical gate stops with retained evidence
decision.control: apply and report historical absolute gates separately; retain every failure

profile.per_path_clock: whole path from context construction through capture, own scoring and replay
profile.extrapolation: for each of 12 paths take maximum over three repeats of whole_path_seconds * (10000000 / actual_final_node_work)
profile.worker_sum: fixed path-index modulo-three sums, T=max of three
profile.admission: all 36 paths complete under 900s and strict 2*(2*T+600)<7200, no favorable retry

publication: protocol before selection; cohort freeze before outcomes; qualified exact source and hosted checks before proof; published and GitHub-byte-verified proof before profile; published profile and separate admission before own study; published/verified own raw before comparison-only native audit; final exact-source local/optional/hosted checks
reference: pinned OpenSpiel 2.0.2 Apache-2.0 license, scalar-only comparison after own publication, 1e-9 chips; no reference strategy or training input
